All records provisional.

characters.summary: Aulë is one of the Aratar, the Valar most powerful in material arts, smithing, and creation. He fights with the knowledge of all substances of Arda and created the Dwarves.

mechanisms: Divine invulnerability typical of an Ainur

limitations: Cannot grant independent free will to creations without Eru Ilúvatar's intervention.

sources.supports: Aulë's role as a Vala, smithing domain, and creation of the Dwarves.

feats.claim: Created the Seven Fathers of the Dwarves in secret before Eru Illúvatar gave them independent life.
feats.citation: The Silmarillion, Of Aulë and Yavanna

campaignTags.claim: Aulë is one of the Valar, possessing high divine magic and creation powers.
Aulë designed and created the race of the Dwarves.

unknowns: Exact direct combat feats against specific individuals in open warfare are minimal compared to his crafting feats.

characters.summary: Azog is a ferocious Orc chieftain of Moria who leads from the front lines with massive strength and brutal weapons. He relies on intimidation, heavy melee combat, and commanding hordes of orcs.

techniques: Brutal melee strikes with scimitar and mace

limitations: Relies entirely on physical strength and tactical leadership.

sources.supports: Azog's role as King of Moria, weapons, and death by Dáin Ironfoot.

feats.claim: Beheaded King Thrór at the gates of Moria.

notableResults.note: Ambushed and killed Thrór outside Moria.
Killed Náin during the Battle of Azanulbizar before being slain.
Slain by the young Dáin Ironfoot at the East-gate of Moria.

unknowns: Differences between book depiction (slain in Appendix A) and Peter Jackson film trilogy depiction (surviving to lead armies at the Battle of the Five Armies).

characters.continuity: The Lord of the Rings / The Hobbit
characters.summary: Balin is a wise and experienced Dwarf warrior who fights with a traditional battle-axe and possesses deep tactical experience from the Lonely Mountain expedition and the colonization of Moria.
limitations: Aged significantly during his later years in Moria.

sources.supports: Balin's role in Thorin's company, expedition to Moria, and death by Orcs.

feats.claim: Survived the Quest of Erebor, fighting in the Battle of the Five Armies.

notableResults.note: Ambushed and killed by an Orc archer in Dimrill Dale.

unknowns: Specific details of his final skirmishes in Moria before being overrun are known only through the Book of Mazarbul.

characters.summary: Bard is a grim, skilled archer of Esgaroth who fights using a great yew bow and the legendary Black Arrow, combining precision marksmanship with resolute leadership.

mechanisms: Standard human armor and defensive positioning

limitations: Limited supply of specialized heavy ammunition like the Black Arrow.

sources.supports: Bard's lineage, shooting down Smaug with the Black Arrow, and kingship of Dale.

feats.claim: Slew the dragon Smaug with a single arrow shot to his unprotected patch of skin.
feats.citation: The Hobbit, Chapter 14: Fire and Water

notableResults.note: Aided by information from a thrush, hit Smaug's bare spot on his chest.

unknowns: Origin of the Black Arrow prior to its appearance in Esgaroth.

characters.summary: Beleg Strongbow is an elite Sindarin elf ranger and warrior of Doriath. He fights with a great black bow named Belthronding and the cursed sword Anglachel, specializing in wilderness survival and precision combat.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to physical mortal wounds despite Elven resilience
mobility: Natural elven running and forest navigation
limitations: Mortal weapons and physical limits apply despite great skill.

sources.supports: Beleg's epithet Strongbow, wielding of Belthronding and Anglachel, and fate.

feats.claim: Fought heroically in the wars of Beleriand, clearing orcs from Taur-nu-Fuin.

notableResults.note: Ambushed and destroyed multiple enemy patrols during the rescue of Túrin.

campaignTags.claim: Wields Anglachel, a blade forged from meteoric iron by Eöl.

unknowns: The exact magical properties of Anglachel beyond hunger for blood.

characters.summary: Beorn is a formidable skin-changer who fights as a giant mortal man using raw physical strength, axes, and intimidation, possessing the ability to transform into an enormous bear.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to weapons when caught off guard
limitations: Relies on his human form for tool use and speech.

sources.supports: Beorn's skin-changing abilities, strength, and role in the Battle of the Five Armies.

feats.claim: Broke through Goblin lines and slew Bolg during the Battle of the Five Armies.
feats.citation: The Hobbit, Chapter 18: The Return Journey

notableResults.note: Crushed Bolg during the Battle of the Five Armies in bear form.

conditional.ability: Bear form physical augmentation and massive size

campaignTags.claim: Can transform into a massive bear significantly larger than normal bears.

unknowns: Exact origin of the skin-changers and whether others of his kind exist.

characters.summary: In Bear Form, Beorn fights as an unstoppable colossal beast, tearing through armor, shields, and ranks of enemies with sheer mass and claw strikes.

mechanisms: Enormous mass and thick fur hide

weaknesses: Inability to use weapons or articulate speech in this form
limitations: Duration of the fury and transformation is tied to his emotional state.
characters.formDifferences: Transforms from a human warrior into a giant, ferocious bear with vastly enhanced strength, durability, and offensive striking power at the cost of dexterity and tool use.

sources.supports: Beorn's bear form feats at the Battle of the Five Armies.

feats.claim: Carried Thorin Oakenshield out of the battle and single-handedly routed Bolg's bodyguard.

notableResults.note: Lifted and tore Bolg apart in bear form.

campaignTags.claim: Transforms into a bear of monstrous, giant proportions.

unknowns: Exact upper limits of his physical lifting capacity in bear form.

characters.summary: Beren is a legendary Edain hero who fights with a sword, guerrilla tactics, and unflinching resolve, famously cutting a Silmaril from Morgoth's iron crown.
limitations: Human physical limits, requiring aid from Lúthien and Huan to overcome major supernatural foes.

sources.supports: Beren's feats in Dorthonion, quest for the Silmaril, and survival.

feats.claim: Survived alone as an outlaw in Dorthonion hunted by Sauron's forces.
feats.citation: The Silmarillion, Of Beren and Lúthien

notableResults.note: Had his hand bitten off by the werewolf Carcharoth while holding the Silmaril.

campaignTags.claim: Used Angrist, a knife forged by Telchar, to cut a Silmaril.

unknowns: Extent of his post-resurrection combat capabilities after returning from the dead.

characters.summary: Bilbo is a Hobbit who relies heavily on stealth, concealment via the One Ring, and clever evasion rather than direct combat, occasionally using his short sword Sting.
weaknesses: Reliance on magical items for defense
limitations: Normal hobbit physical attributes without magical gear.

sources.supports: Bilbo's use of the Ring, Sting, and the Mithril coat.

feats.claim: Slew a giant spider in Mirkwood with Sting.
feats.citation: The Hobbit, Chapter 8: Flies and Spiders

notableResults.note: Used the Ring and Sting to rescue the Dwarves from Mirkwood spiders.

campaignTags.claim: Becomes invisible when wearing the One Ring.
Expert at moving silently and remaining hidden from enemies.

unknowns: The psychological corruptive toll of prolonged Ring use on a hobbit compared to others.

characters.summary: Bolg is a massive and brutal Orc chieftain of Mount Gundabad who fights with a heavy spiked mace, commanding disciplined goblin regiments and bodyguard units.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to superior monstrous strength (such as Beorn)
limitations: Relies on brute force and military numbers rather than tactical flexibility.

sources.supports: Bolg's role as son of Azog, commander at the Battle of the Five Armies, and death by Beorn.

feats.claim: Led a vast army of Goblins and Wargs to reclaim the Lonely Mountain.
feats.citation: The Hobbit, Chapter 17: The Clouds Burst

notableResults.note: Rend apart by Beorn in bear form during the climax of the Battle of the Five Armies.

unknowns: Exact inventory of personal weapons beyond his heavy iron mace.
